title: The adversary's answers on whether suspected defects can be reproduced

candidate.description: The commit these answers were tried against.

answers.description: One entry per finding id the dispatch handed over, and nothing else: there is no place here for a finding of your own. A finding with no entry is not answered, and stays as it was.

id.description: The finding's id, copied unchanged from the candidates file.

outcome.description: reproduced: you ran something that showed the defect. not-reproduced: you tried and the defect did not show, or you could not try it.

command.description: The command you ran that showed the defect, as it could be run again. For not-reproduced, what you tried, or an empty string when you could not run anything.

saw.description: What the command printed or did that shows the defect. For not-reproduced, what you saw instead, or an empty string. An empty one on a reproduced answer is read as no answer.
